about.title: ABOUT US
about.mainText: Triangle HR Solutions is a professionally managed learning and human resource development organization dedicated to building industry-ready talent and strengthening organizational capability.
about.subText: With over a decade of experience, we design impactful training programs that help individuals and organizations build the skills, mindset, and capabilities needed for the future of work.
solutions: Professionals enhancing leadership and employability skills

framework.label: Strategic Framework
framework.title: How We Guide Growth
framework.description: Our vision, mission, and objectives are integrated to ensure every learner and organization reaches their full potential.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.text: To be a trusted partner in shaping confident, skilled, and future-ready professionals who thrive in a changing world.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.text: To connect learning with real-world success by helping individuals grow with confidence and enabling organizations.

pillars.title: Our Objective
pillars.text: Connecting learning with real-world impact by developing capable people, strong organizations, and future-ready careers.
